METALWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Heat treatment of steel, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Heat treatment of steel.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Heat treatment of steel.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Heat treatment of steel.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Heat treatment of steel.

2. When learning Assembly Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawings.

3. When learning Centre La, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Centre La.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Centre La.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Centre La.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Centre La.

4. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

5. When learning Career Opportunities in Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Metalwork.

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

7. When learning Gas Welding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Gas Welding.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Gas Welding.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Gas Welding.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.

8. When learning Metalwork related businesses, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork related businesses.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork related businesses.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork related businesses.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork related businesses.

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

10. When learning Surface Finishing Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Finishing Processes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Finishing Processes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Surface Finishing Processes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Finishing Processes.

11. When learning Project 1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 1.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project 1.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 1.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 1.

12. When learning Project 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 2.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 2.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 2.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Project 2.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Assembly Drawings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Gas Welding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Forging and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
